mapper.select: SELECT SUBSTR(AA.YM,1,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(AA.YM,5,2) AS YM, NVL(BB.CNT,0) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT #{statsYear} || LPAD(LEVEL,2,'0') YM FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) AA, ( SELECT SUBSTR(JOIN_APRV_YMD,1,6) YM, COUNT(*) CNT FROM SAA200 WHERE 1 = 1 AND YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(JOIN_APRV_YMD,0,4) = #{statsYear} GROUP BY SUBSTR(JOIN_APRV_YMD,1,6) ) BB WHERE AA.YM = BB.YM(+) ORDER BY YM

SELECT AA.DD || '일' AS DD, --일자 NVL(BB.CNT,0) AS CNT --가입수 FROM ( SELECT LPAD(LEVEL,2,'0') DD FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{statsYM}, 'YYYYMM')),'DD') ) AA, ( SELECT SUBSTR(JOIN_APRV_YMD,7,2) DD, COUNT(*) CNT FROM SAA200 WHERE 1 = 1 AND YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL --내담자 AND SUBSTR(JOIN_APRV_YMD,0,6) = #{statsYM} GROUP BY JOIN_APRV_YMD ) BB WHERE AA.DD = BB.DD(+) ORDER BY AA.DD
